articles.title: Patrick Mahomes' multi-million-dollar investment in Kansas City Royals includes additional $5 million earmarked for the homeless
articles.standfirst: MLB franchise is backing a homelessness initiative as part of a much larger community package
articles.summary: MLB franchise is backing a homelessness initiative as part of a much larger community package
articles.body:
Patrick Mahomes ’ connection to Kansas City has long extended beyond football, but one of his most prominent investments is now taking on a bigger role in the city’s community development plans.

The Kansas City Royals , whose ownership group Mahomes joined in 2020, have committed $5 million to the city’s Housing Gateway Program as part of a broader agreement connected to a proposed $1.9 billion stadium project at Crown Center.

The contribution is one piece of a larger package that would require the Royals to provide at least $55 million in community benefits over the life of a 30-year lease.

Royals president Brooks Sherman said the team wanted to identify projects where the money could have a direct impact.

“Five-million-dollar contributions for the city’s Housing Gateway Program and its efforts to fund solutions to homelessness,” Sherman said. “We believe we selected meaningful projects and scopes to best put these funds to use on behalf of the city…”

$5 million could have wider effect

The value of the commitment may extend beyond the money itself. Josh Henges , Kansas City’s chief impact officer for Homeless Solutions, said the Royals ’ involvement could help attract additional investment to the program.

“It’s gonna get easier,” Henges said. “The more investors you have and the amount of investment they bring in to include the name of the Royals. To us what that signals, yes the money’s gonna do amazing things, it’s gonna bring in more investment.

"That’s what I see this five million dollars as… It shows that this innovation is something that’s catching people’s attention…”

Mahomes ' place in the Royals ’ ownership group makes the move another notable extension of his influence in Kansas City.

Mahomes’ investment has grown

Mahomes became a minority owner of the Royals on July 28, 2020, joining the group led by chairman and CEO John Sherman .

His exact stake has never been publicly disclosed, but the franchise is now valued at around $1.64 billion, making it one of the most substantial investments tied to the Chiefs quarterback’s expanding business portfolio.

The move also fits with Mahomes ’ broader pattern of community involvement.

His 15 and the Mahomies Foundation has backed literacy programs, youth initiatives and projects supporting homeless and at-risk children across Kansas City.

In 2025, the foundation donated $15,000 to the Kansas City Public Library’s Summer Reading Program, helping fund nearly 6,000 books for local children.

“Reading every day is so important,” Mahomes said at the time. “It helps us grow, learn, and dream big.”

The foundation also donated $15,000 to HALO’s Fresh Start Fund, which helped provide clothing and basic essentials for homeless children moving into new housing.

The Royals ’ latest commitment is much larger, but it follows the same wider theme.

Mahomes remains focused on trying to lead the Chiefs back toward another Super Bowl run, yet his footprint across Kansas City continues to grow in ways that have little to do with what happens on Sundays.

articles.standfirst: Taylor Swift is adding a new skill to her routine — and she is already sharing the results with her crew
articles.summary: Taylor Swift is adding a new skill to her routine — and she is already sharing the results with her crew
articles.body:
C reativity has always been part of Taylor Swift’s world, and apparently, that also includes the kitchen. A new video showed the pop star embracing a new era in her life: baking sourdough bread and bringing it to set for her staff and crew.

Swift starts her day at 4 a.m.

Business may be one of Swift’s strengths, but when it comes to baking, she is giving the product away for free . In the video, the singer was seen waking up very early to prepare the bread before taking it to set and sharing it with the people working around her.

Despite the early start, Swift was already in a joking mood. The video showed her arriving on set with fresh sourdough for the crew, a gesture that appeared to touch the staff members who received it.

Her baking joke leaves the crew laughing

Swift explained that she had been up since 4 a.m. and was already feeling fully awake as she walked around the set. She joked that starting the day with a fresh bake was one of the benefits of waking up so early, before adding that she was talking about the kind of “baking” musicians are not usually known for.

The joke played on the double meaning of “bake,” catching the crew off guard and sending them into laughter. Swift had reportedly baked the loaves herself, offering two varieties: original and blueberry lemon.

After the staff thanked her, Swift kept the joke going by referring to her baking as her own small, free business . It was another glimpse of the pop star’s sense of humor while she shared something she had spent the early hours of the morning making herself.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes knows why Kenneth Walker III is thriving as the Chiefs star reacts to his Player of the Month honor
articles.standfirst: Walker has proven to be the best offseason move in the NFL this year, and the Chiefs are back in contention
articles.summary: Walker has proven to be the best offseason move in the NFL this year, and the Chiefs are back in contention
articles.body:
The 2026 NFL season moves fast, and with the first month of the campaign concluded, the NFL announced its Players of the Month , honoring San Francisco 49ers quarterback Brock Purdy in the NFC alongside new Kansas City Chiefs running back Kenneth Walker III in the AFC, both securing the prestigious offensive accolade for the first time in their careers.

Purdy has powered the 49ers to an unblemished 3-0 record by airing it out for 789 passing yards and a league-leading nine touchdowns , orchestrating an explosive offense that has put up 27, 35, and 36 points.

Meanwhile, in the AFC, Chiefs workhorse Kenneth Walker III has taken the conference by storm, becoming the fourth running back to win the award in the last five months, dating back to last season.

Walker currently leads the entire NFL in rushing yards with 360 alongside four total touchdowns , making him only the second non-Patrick Mahomes player from Kansas City to claim the monthly honor since 2017, joining Jerick McKinnon (December 2022).

Kahlil Benson Joins Walker as Chiefs Sweep September Honors

Walker wasn't the only standout shining in Kansas City, as undrafted offensive lineman Kahlil Benson was named NFL Offensive Rookie of the Month after allowing a mere six pressures, the third-fewest in the league, and anchoring a revamped Chiefs offensive line that surrendered a league-low four sacks in the AFC.

Having a dominant running back and a stellar rookie blocker driving success is a dream scenario for Patrick Mahomes , especially with the Chiefs' offense looking completely unstoppable behind a balanced ground attack and elite protection.

Addressing reporters on Thursday, Walker reflected on his explosive start and his expanding role in the passing game: "It means a lot, but that's like a testament to the guys up front and everybody that's blocking for me, wide receivers, tight ends," Walker stated.

articles.title: ‘I just get blanked’: Chiefs legend Larry Johnson fears CTE after years of NFL hits
articles.standfirst: The former running back believes he has the symptoms of a neurodegenerative disease associated with repeated head impacts
articles.summary: The former running back believes he has the symptoms of a neurodegenerative disease associated with repeated head impacts
articles.body:
Two decades after Larry Johnson was one of the NFL’s most heavily used running backs, the former Kansas City Chiefs star is still dealing with what he believes could be the long-term effects of his playing career. At 46, Johnson says his memory problems have become difficult to ignore.

According to report by ESPN's Stephen Holder, Johnson described episodes in which he has forgotten where he parked his car, lost track of where he was while driving and experienced periods when his surroundings seemed to disappear from his awareness.

“My short-term memory was so bad, I could literally go into a store and 30 minutes later come out and not know where my car is parked,” Johnson told ESPN . “Or, I’m driving and I just get blanked and I don’t even know where I’m going or know where I’m at.” Johnson believes those symptoms could be connected to chronic traumatic encephalopathy, commonly known as CTE , a neurodegenerative disease associated with repeated head impacts.

But there is an important distinction: Johnson does not have a confirmed CTE diagnosis. CTE can currently be definitively diagnosed only after death, through examination of brain tissue. The clinical syndrome associated with symptoms during life is referred to as traumatic encephalopathy syndrome, or TES.

The symptoms have been there for years

Johnson's concerns about his brain health did not begin recently. In 2017, he described memory lapses and dramatic mood changes during an interview with the BBC. “The other day I tried to open my car with my TV remote,” Johnson said at the time. “I don’t even know how I had the TV remote in my hand.”

He also described periods in which his mood could change rapidly, going from feeling fine to becoming sad or depressed before returning to a better mood.

Those experiences have remained part of Johnson's post-NFL story. His latest comments are particularly striking because they involve problems with everyday activities rather than isolated moments of forgetfulness. And they come from a former running back whose career was defined by an extraordinary workload.

Johnson's NFL workload was enormous

The Chiefs selected Johnson in the first round of the 2003 NFL draft, and he quickly developed into one of the league's most productive running backs. He earned Pro Bowl selections in 2005 and 2006, rushing for more than 1,700 yards in each season. Then came one of the most remarkable workload seasons in NFL history.

In 2006, Johnson carried the ball 416 times, setting an NFL single-season record that still stands. He rushed for 1,789 yards and scored 17 touchdowns that season. His workload wasn't limited to that one year. During his seven seasons with Kansas City, Johnson accumulated 1,526 touches.

For a running back, those touches meant repeated collisions with defenders, the kind of routine contact that makes the position one of football's most physically demanding. Johnson's career then deteriorated rapidly. During his final two seasons, with Washington and Miami, he appeared in only three games and had six rushing attempts for four yards. His physical decline was stark compared with the player who had once carried the Chiefs' offense.

What scientists know, and don't know, about CTE

Research has established an association between CTE and repetitive head impacts, including those sustained in contact sports. A 2023 consensus paper noted that more than 97% of published CTE cases involved people with known exposure to repetitive head impacts.

But symptoms such as memory problems, depression, impulsivity and mood changes are not specific to CTE. They can occur in multiple neurological and psychiatric conditions, which is one reason diagnosing the disease during life remains so difficult. That distinction matters for former players such as Johnson.

A person can experience significant cognitive or behavioral symptoms without those symptoms proving that CTE is the cause. Research is nevertheless moving toward finding ways to identify the disease during life. A 2023 study of former professional football players examined brain imaging and other measures as researchers continued searching for biomarkers that could eventually help identify CTE-related pathology in living people.

Researchers at Boston University and elsewhere have also continued investigating how neurological testing, imaging and other biomarkers might eventually improve diagnosis. For former players, the potential implications are significant. A reliable diagnosis could help physicians distinguish symptoms associated with CTE from other potentially treatable conditions.

articles.title: Chiefs Ref Controversy: The real reason flag was pulled out before Patrick Mahomes even hit the ground
articles.standfirst: Another week, another conspiracy theory with the Kansas City Chiefs and NFL referees.
articles.summary: Another week, another conspiracy theory with the Kansas City Chiefs and NFL referees.
articles.body:
Seemingly too often, the Kansas City Chiefs become embroiled in referee controversies. Sometimes it's warranted, but most of the time it's just fans trying to find excuses against a team that keeps winning games.

In Week 3, another conspiracy theory emerged thanks to a roughing the passer penalty against the Miami Dolphins that occurred in the Chiefs' own end zone with the game at 17-10. The Chiefs got a first down on 3rd-and-9 thanks to the penalty, then went on to kick a field goal and put the game out of reach .

More than the decision to throw a flag on the play due to the defender making a " body weight " tackle that was bang-bang, fans picked up on the referee reaching for his flag before Patrick Mahomes was even hit . Many believed it was a clear case of preemptive bias. But that's not the case at all.

Zach Sieler clearly committed defensive holding penalty on play Patrick Mahomes earned a roughing the passer penalty

In fact, the referee was reaching for his flag for a different penalty , also against the Dolphins. Zach Sieler was called for a defensive holding penalty . Non-Chiefs fans tried to argue that the holding penalty was also a ticky-tack call, but the film shows Sieler clearly holding the right guard's arm, which doesn't allow him to block the defender that ended up hitting Mahomes .

The roughing the passer call certainly appeared somewhat subjective, but even if it wasn't called, the Dolphins were going to get flagged for defensive holding by Sieler. That would have been an automatic first down, just not as much yardage as the roughing the passer penalty.

articles.title: The Chiefs are working behind the scenes to sign Tyreek Hill, but another NFL team won't make it easy for them
articles.standfirst: Tyreek Hill's latest workout video has intensified speculation about a possible Kansas City reunion, but the Chiefs may face competition
articles.summary: Tyreek Hill's latest workout video has intensified speculation about a possible Kansas City reunion, but the Chiefs may face competition
articles.body:
T yreek Hill 's potential return to the NFL is becoming one of the most intriguing storylines of the 2026 season, and the Kansas City Chiefs have naturally emerged as one of the teams connected with the veteran wide receiver.

The speculation surrounding Hill has accelerated over the past week after the former Chiefs star hinted that he was nearing a return.

He previously suggested it was “almost time” for him to “get back to work”, before another social media post about wanting some cold weather further fueled talk of a possible Kansas City reunion.

Now, Hill has provided another reason for interested teams to pay attention.

The 32-year-old recently shared workout footage showing him running routes, and the video offered an encouraging glimpse of the physical progress he has made since suffering a serious knee injury last season.

As Sun Sentinel reporter David Furones highlighted, one of the most notable aspects of the footage was Hill's quick-twitch movement and lateral ability.

The video shows the receiver working at the line of scrimmage, simulating a one-on-one matchup with a defensive back before breaking down the seam.

For Hill , those movements could be particularly significant.

He suffered a dislocated knee and multiple ligament injuries, including a torn ACL, during the 2025 season. After undergoing two surgeries, Hill spent much of 2026 working his way back toward football shape.

The Miami Dolphins ultimately released him in February after he failed his physical, making him a free agent.

Why Kansas City remains such an obvious destination

Hill's relationship with the Chiefs makes Kansas City an obvious team to monitor.

He spent the first six seasons of his NFL career with the franchise after being selected in the fifth round of the 2016 draft, developing into one of the league's most dangerous deep threats alongside Patrick Mahomes and Travis Kelce.

A return would also reunite Hill with head coach Andy Reid and offensive coordinator Eric Bieniemy .

Bieniemy 's return is particularly notable. Kansas City brought him back as offensive coordinator in January 2026, marking his second stint in that role after previously serving as the team's offensive coordinator from 2018 through 2022.

During that original run, the Chiefs produced some of the NFL's most prolific offenses, with Hill playing a major role in the early Mahomes era.

There is therefore plenty of familiarity for Hill if he eventually chooses Kansas City. However, the Chiefs are not necessarily the only contender for his services.

Reuters reported that Hill's agent, Drew Rosenhaus , has indicated that the receiver is looking to join a contender, with the Green Bay Packers , Buffalo Bills and Baltimore Ravens among the teams discussed alongside Kansas City. That creates a significant complication for the Chiefs .

The Bills , for example, already have Josh Allen throwing to a receiving group that includes DJ Moore, Keon Coleman, Joshua Palmer and Khalil Shakir . Green Bay likewise entered 2026 with Christian Watson, Jayden Reed and first-round pick Matthew Golden among its receivers.

Hill's health will ultimately remain central to any decision. In July, he acknowledged that he still had significant work to do, explaining that he had “no power” in his injured left leg while continuing his rehabilitation. NFL.com also reported at the time that Hill had not provided a timetable for his return.

His agent later said Hill was not ready to sign before the season and emphasized that the priority was making sure he returned at his best rather than rushing the process.

The latest route-running footage suggests Hill is continuing to move forward, but it does not establish when he will be medically cleared or which team he will ultimately join.

For Kansas City, the opportunity is clear: a healthy Hill would bring elite speed, familiarity with Mahomes and Reid, and experience in the Chiefs' offensive system.

But with other contenders potentially interested, Kansas City may have to compete for the former All-Pro if Hill decides that his comeback is ready to begin.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes shares the part of his comeback that NFL fans didn’t see
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes offered a glimpse into that part of his comeback journey during the Chiefs Kingdom Show, explaining just how much work went into his recovery from the knee injury that ended his 2025 season. At one point, Mahomes was spending roughly seven hours a day at the Chiefs' facility working through his rehabilitation. Head coach Andy Reid had previously described how Mahomes was at the facility for hours every day, working alongside assistant athletic trainer Julie Frymyer. That was the part of the comeback that most people never saw. And while Mahomes was spending much of his day rehabbing, his family had to adjust around the process. That is where his wife, Brittany Mahomes, entered the story.

articles.title: The Raiders must stop the Chiefs’ biggest weapon, who’s not Patrick Mahomes, if they want to beat them
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City offense that has evolved into a much more balanced attack
articles.summary: The Kansas City offense that has evolved into a much more balanced attack
articles.body:
T he Las Vegas Raiders have spent the first three weeks of the 2026 season answering questions nobody expected them to face this early. Are they actually this good?

Can Kirk Cousins keep the offense rolling? Can the defense make enough plays to sustain an undefeated start?

On Sunday, the Raiders will face their biggest test yet when the 3-0 Kansas City Chiefs visit Allegiant Stadium . And according to NFL.com senior staff editor Brooke Cersosimo, one matchup could determine whether Las Vegas remains unbeaten: Kenneth Walker III.

The Chiefs' running back enters Week 4 as the NFL's leading rusher, and Cersosimo identified limiting Walker as a "huge key" to the game in her NFL.com matchup analysis. She picked the Raiders to win 26-24. That puts the spotlight directly on a Kansas City offense that has evolved into a much more balanced attack.

Kenneth Walker has changed the Chiefs' offense

Patrick Mahomes remains the centerpiece , but Kansas City's early success has not been built entirely around its quarterback. Walker has given the Chiefs a legitimate rushing threat capable of changing the way defenses approach them. Through three games, Walker has rushed 65 times for 360 yards, averaging 5.5 yards per carry, while adding two rushing touchdowns. He has also caught 11 passes for 82 yards.

His first three performances illustrate the problem facing Las Vegas. Walker opened the season with 173 rushing yards against Denver, followed that with 117 against Indianapolis and then added 70 rushing yards and a rushing touchdown against Miami. He also caught six passes for 61 yards against the Colts.

The Raiders cannot simply focus on Mahomes and assume the Chiefs will have to win through the air. That would create exactly the kind of opening Walker has exploited throughout the first three weeks. Cersosimo pointed to Mahomes' return toward his MVP-caliber level as another reason Kansas City's offense has become increasingly dangerous.

With Eric Bieniemy back as offensive coordinator, the Chiefs have paired Mahomes' passing ability with a more productive ground game. That combination creates a different problem for Las Vegas. If the Raiders commit too heavily to stopping Walker, Mahomes has the ability to punish them. If they prioritize keeping Patrick contained, Walker can force the defense to repeatedly defend the run.

The Raiders need to prevent Kansas City from dictating those terms

This is not the same Raiders team that has struggled to establish itself in recent seasons. Las Vegas is 3-0 and enters Sunday with the NFL's best turnover differential at plus-five. The defense is also tied for fifth in the league with 10 sacks, giving the Raiders two of the ingredients they need to challenge an offense as experienced as Kansas City's : takeaways and pressure.

The offense has also developed an identity. Cousins has thrown three touchdown passes in each of the Raiders ' first three games while working in Klint Kubiak's system . Through three games, he has 661 passing yards, nine touchdowns and three interceptions. And he has an intriguing matchup against a Kansas City defense that frequently uses man coverage.

According to the data cited by Cersosimo, the Chiefs have played man coverage on 37.6 percent of opposing dropbacks, fifth-most in the NFL. Cousins has been particularly productive against man this season, posting six touchdown passes, no interceptions and a 126.2 passer rating in those situations.

That gives Las Vegas a path to attack. Brock Bowers and Ashton Jeanty have to deliver The Raiders will need more than Cousins to beat Kansas City. Cersosimo specifically highlighted Brock Bowers and Ashton Jeanty as players who need to make an impact.

Bowers is coming off a Week 3 performance that earned him AFC Offensive Player of the Week honors, while Jeanty provides Las Vegas with another explosive element out of the backfield. The Raiders will need both players to force Kansas City's defense to account for more than Cousins and the passing game. That could be especially important if the Chiefs try to make Cousins beat them from the pocket.

articles.title: Kenneth Walker III strengthens his bond with his new teammate after both suffered a serious illness
articles.standfirst: A frightening health scare has brought two Chiefs teammates closer as they build a bond on and off the field
articles.summary: A frightening health scare has brought two Chiefs teammates closer as they build a bond on and off the field
articles.body:
Kansas City Chiefs teammates Trey Smith and Kenneth Walker III have developed an unusual connection, one built not on growing up in the same place or sharing a college locker room, but on surviving pulmonary embolisms.

Smith recently opened up about their relationship while discussing the “Stop the Clot” campaign, explaining that he initially didn’t know Walker had also experienced the serious condition.

Once the two discovered their shared journey, they quickly found another level of respect for one another.

“When K9 first got here, I didn’t realize he had a pulmonary embolism as well, so that was like a crazy thing,” said Smith while speaking to Sports Radio 810 WHB.

“We definitely both have a lot of respect for each other. Going through a circumstance, situation like that, it’s serious. Having the same exact symptoms, same feelings — it’s just like, damn, someone else has been through that same physical issue.”

Smith’s ordeal began during his sophomore season at Tennessee in 2018. He was diagnosed with blood clots in his lungs after experiencing severe breathing difficulties.

His problems became particularly alarming when he struggled during practice and eventually passed out.

articles.standfirst: Taylor Swift has become a familiar face at Travis Kelce's Chiefs games, but Sunday's trip to Las Vegas could be different for several reasons
articles.summary: Taylor Swift has become a familiar face at Travis Kelce's Chiefs games, but Sunday's trip to Las Vegas could be different for several reasons
articles.body:
T aylor Swift 's presence at Kansas City Chiefs games has become one of the biggest storylines surrounding the NFL , but fans may have to wait until the last minute to discover whether she will be alongside Travis Kelce for Sunday's meeting with the Las Vegas Raiders .

The Chiefs travel to Allegiant Stadium on Sunday, October 4, with both Kansas City and Las Vegas entering Week 4 with perfect 3-0 records.

The game is therefore significant for both teams on the field, but Swift's potential attendance has added another layer of intrigue to the matchup. At this stage, there is no official confirmation that Swift will attend the game.

That is important because the singer has generally been much more likely to appear at home games than road contests.

Cosmopolitan's overview of Kansas City 's 2026 schedule noted that Swift typically attends games at Arrowhead Stadium because of security considerations surrounding appearances at unfamiliar venues. That pattern makes Sunday's matchup a particularly interesting one.

Swift was present for the Chiefs ' first two home games of the season against the Denver Broncos and Indianapolis Colts , but she did not travel to Miami when Kansas City faced the Dolphins in Week 3.

The Dolphins game also coincided with the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards, where Swift was in Los Angeles and collected major honors.

There is another reason why speculation has continued despite the lack of confirmation.

Taylor Swift's possible surprise appearance may come before the game

The original Yahoo report did not actually establish that Swift would be inside Allegiant Stadium. Instead, the speculation surrounding her weekend has centered on the possibility of a surprise television appearance.

Fans have been discussing whether Swift could make a cameo on Saturday Night Live, which is being hosted this weekend by Dakota Johnson .

The theory gained traction because Johnson recently appeared in Swift's "Patient Zero" music video and presented Swift with the Artist Director Honors at the 2026 VMAs.

The friendship between the two stars has also added fuel to the idea. Johnson recently described Swift as a close friend and discussed how she became involved with the singer's latest project.

Swift has appeared on SNL before, including a surprise appearance in 2023, so the idea is not completely unprecedented. However, it remains fan speculation rather than a confirmed booking.

There is also a significant practical issue with the Chiefs-Raiders game itself.

Swift has not attended one of Kelce's road games since the 2024 season, according to the recent reporting surrounding Sunday's matchup. Security has previously been cited as a major reason for that pattern, with additional planning required whenever she visits a stadium away from Kansas City.

That does not make a Las Vegas appearance impossible, but it does make it harder to predict.

The stakes on the field could also make this one of the most attractive games of the early NFL season. Kansas City and Las Vegas are both 3-0, meaning the winner will take an early advantage in the AFC West.

The Chiefs have also bounced back strongly after missing the playoffs in the previous season, with Kelce enjoying an impressive start to his campaign.

Kelce has already recorded 231 receiving yards and two touchdowns through the opening three games, while also setting an NFL record for career receiving yards after the catch. His resurgence has become one of the stories of Kansas City's unbeaten start.

Swift's relationship with Kelce has obviously made her attendance a major talking point, but the football matchup itself should not be overlooked.

For now, the safest conclusion is that Taylor Swift's attendance at Chiefs-Raiders has not been confirmed.

Her recent preference for home games, the security considerations involved with road appearances and her previous absence from Kansas City's trip to Miami all point toward caution.

However, with Swift's ability to make surprise appearances, and with speculation about a possible SNL cameo involving Dakota Johnson , there is still plenty of reason for fans to keep watching for an unexpected appearance.

If Swift does turn up in Las Vegas, it would represent a departure from her recent Chiefs-game routine. If she does not, that would be entirely consistent with the pattern she has established over the past couple of seasons.

Either way, the attention will be enormous when the Chiefs and Raiders meet at Allegiant Stadium, with Kansas City's unbeaten record, Kelce's continued resurgence and Swift's possible appearance all competing for the spotlight.

articles.title: The Chiefs could make a surprise move to sign a veteran wide receiver, which would sideline Tyreek Hill
articles.standfirst: Kansas City may look to add another experienced pass-catcher before the trade deadline, but the latest prediction suggests a quieter move than a reunion with Tyreek Hill
articles.summary: Kansas City may look to add another experienced pass-catcher before the trade deadline, but the latest prediction suggests a quieter move than a reunion with Tyreek Hill
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs have started the 2026 NFL season at 3-0, but their unbeaten record has not stopped speculation that Patrick Mahomes could receive another weapon before the trade deadline.

Kansas City has until November 10 to make a move, and ESPN's Dan Graziano believes the Chiefs could once again become active in the trade market. The expectation, however, is not necessarily that Andy Reid 's team will chase the biggest available name.

Instead, Graziano has predicted that Kansas City could make what he described as an “unexciting trade” for another wide receiver.

That projection is particularly interesting because the Chiefs have already been linked with considerably more eye-catching possibilities.

Brian Thomas Jr. has emerged as one name connected to Kansas City, while Arizona's Marvin Harrison Jr. and Cleveland's Jerry Jeudy have also been identified as receivers who could potentially become available.

None of those players has been confirmed as a Chiefs target, though, and Graziano's assessment suggests that Kansas City could once again favor experience and practicality over making a blockbuster acquisition.

“While the Chiefs always seem to make a move at the deadline, it’s more often to add a player such as Kadarius Toney or late-career DeAndre Hopkins than a Breece Hall or Jaylen Waddle ,” Graziano wrote in his October 2 ESPN story.

That history matters when considering another name that has dominated Chiefs-related speculation in recent days: Tyreek Hill .

Hill is currently a free agent after being released by the Miami Dolphins in February. The eight-time Pro Bowl receiver recently reignited interest in his future with a cryptic social-media post indicating that he was ready for “some cold weather.”

His history with Kansas City has naturally made the Chiefs one of the most discussed destinations.

A reunion with Mahomes would be spectacular, but it would not fit particularly neatly with Graziano's prediction of an inexpensive or low-profile deadline addition.

Kansas City has reasons to strengthen the receiver room

The Chiefs ' need for another receiver is not necessarily an indication that their offense is failing.

In fact, Kansas City has looked considerably more balanced than it did during stretches of last season.

The arrival of Kenneth Walker III has been particularly important. Walker scored twice against Miami in Week 3, including a receiving touchdown, as Kansas City defeated the Dolphins 24-10 to move to 3-0.

Mahomes has also continued to have a reliable connection with Travis Kelce , while Rashee Rice remains an important part of the passing attack.

The bigger question concerns the depth behind those primary options.

Xavier Worthy has yet to produce the kind of statistical impact some expected, although Kansas City's coaching staff has emphasized that his contribution cannot be measured purely through receiving numbers.

Offensive coordinator Eric Bieniemy has specifically praised Worthy's work as a blocker.

“He’s actually doing a hell of a job in the run game,” Bieniemy said. “He’s blocking. Everybody has fully accepted their role.”

Bieniemy also emphasized that Kansas City's players are focused on winning rather than individual statistics.

That philosophy helps explain why Worthy's relatively modest receiving production has not automatically translated into a loss of confidence from the coaching staff.

Still, adding a veteran receiver could give Mahomes another dependable option for the stretch run.

The Chiefs have made similar moves before. Their acquisitions of Kadarius Toney and a veteran DeAndre Hopkins illustrate the kind of calculated deadline additions that can provide experience without requiring the organization to completely reshape its roster. That could be the model again in 2026.

A player such as Harrison or Thomas would obviously generate much more attention, but there are practical reasons for Kansas City to avoid paying a premium for a star who would need to learn Reid's offense and establish chemistry with Mahomes in the middle of the season.

The Chiefs ' offense is already operating effectively, ranking among the NFL's most explosive units through three weeks.

Six different Kansas City players had already recorded catches of at least 20 yards entering Week 4, suggesting Mahomes is spreading the ball around rather than relying entirely on one receiver. That makes a veteran addition more of a luxury than an emergency.

It also makes a Tyreek Hill reunion less necessary from a football perspective, even if it would be enormously attractive from a storyline standpoint.

Hill's recovery from the serious knee injury he suffered during the 2025 season remains another consideration.

Although he has been working out and is reportedly looking for a contender, Kansas City would need to determine how much explosiveness remains and whether bringing him back would be worth the financial and roster implications.

For now, the most credible expectation is therefore much less dramatic than the Hill reunion many Chiefs fans would love to see.

Kansas City could add another receiver before November 10, but the evidence points toward a sensible veteran acquisition rather than a massive trade.

If the Chiefs continue winning, the front office may decide that one additional experienced target is enough to give Mahomes everything he needs for another Super Bowl push.

And if that happens, Tyreek Hill could remain on the outside looking in, not because Kansas City has no interest in him, but because the team may prefer a smaller, more manageable move that addresses its depth without disrupting an offense that is already clicking.

articles.title: Is Taylor Swift celebrating Travis Kelce's Birthday this year? What the newlyweds may be planning for his special day
articles.standfirst: Travis Kelce's birthday arrives just as the Chiefs face the Raiders, giving Taylor Swift and her husband another unusual weekend to celebrate together
articles.summary: Travis Kelce's birthday arrives just as the Chiefs face the Raiders, giving Taylor Swift and her husband another unusual weekend to celebrate together
articles.body:
T aylor Swift and Travis Kelce have already experienced plenty of major milestones together, but this weekend brings another first for the newlyweds: Kelce's first birthday since the couple got married.

Kelce's birthday falls on October 5, meaning the Kansas City Chiefs tight end will celebrate the occasion on Monday, just one day after his team's Week 4 trip to face the Las Vegas Raiders .

The couple married in July in a star-studded celebration at New York City's Madison Square Garden, making this the first birthday they will spend as husband and wife.

Kelce has spoken positively about the wedding since the event, describing it as “the best night of my life.”

However, there is no public confirmation about what Swift and Kelce have planned for his birthday.

That does not mean there is nothing happening behind the scenes. In fact, the timing gives them a potentially unusual opportunity to celebrate. Kansas City plays Las Vegas on Sunday afternoon, meaning Kelce's birthday comes immediately after a significant AFC West matchup.

And there is a good chance football will dominate at least part of the weekend.

The Chiefs entered the Raiders game with a perfect 3-0 record, while Kelce has enjoyed an impressive beginning to his 2026 campaign.

Through the first three games, he had accumulated 231 receiving yards and two touchdowns, while his improved production helped Kansas City make a strong start after missing the playoffs in 2025.

Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce have already celebrated major occasions together

The birthday comes at an interesting time for the pair because they have kept much of their newlywed life relatively private.

After their wedding, Swift and Kelce were photographed enjoying a New York date night in September. The couple visited Ambassadors Clubhouse in NoMad, marking one of their first public appearances together following their wedding celebrations.

They have also recently been spotted celebrating another important occasion with the Chiefs ' inner circle. Swift and Kelce attended Patrick Mahomes' 31st birthday celebration at 1587 Prime in Kansas City in September, giving fans a glimpse of the couple together after their wedding.

That could offer a clue about the kind of birthday Kelce might prefer.

There is a precedent for a relatively low-key celebration. When Kelce turned 36 in 2025, he spent the day with family while preparing for Kansas City's upcoming Monday Night Football game against the Jacksonville Jaguars .

Swift was also involved in the celebrations, with the Kelce family sharing a photo from the occasion.

Interestingly, Kelce has previously admitted that birthdays are not particularly important to him.

Ahead of his 36th birthday, he told Jason Kelce on the New Heights podcast: “It’s not a good day, it’s just an annoying day for me,” before adding, “I don’t want to get into the Grinch of birthdays, but I’m just not in on birthdays.”

That attitude may mean Swift does not need to organize an enormous birthday extravaganza.

There is another factor that could influence the celebrations: Kelce is currently focused heavily on football. The 2026 season represents his 14th NFL campaign, and he entered the year after contemplating his future following Kansas City's disappointing 2025 season.

He ultimately decided to return for another season.

His decision has been rewarded with an encouraging start. The Chiefs began the season 3-0, while Kelce's form has been one of the positive stories surrounding the team.

For Swift , meanwhile, the weekend has already been particularly busy. On October 3, she made a surprise appearance on Saturday Night Live during Dakota Johnson 's monologue, further adding to a packed weekend for the singer. Johnson is a close friend of Swift and attended the couple's wedding.

That makes the exact details of Kelce's birthday plans even harder to predict.

A huge public party seems unlikely based on what Kelce has said previously about birthdays. A private celebration with Swift and family would fit much more naturally with the couple's approach since getting married.

There is also the possibility that Swift could mark the occasion publicly, as she has done for important moments in Kelce's life in the past. But unless either star reveals plans, fans will have to wait to see whether the birthday produces another public appearance.

One thing is certain: October 5 will be a memorable birthday for Kelce regardless of how he celebrates it. He is entering it as a newlywed, with the Chiefs unbeaten and his own football form providing plenty of reasons to be optimistic.

For the first time, Swift will be celebrating the occasion not as Kelce's girlfriend or fiancée, but as his wife. Whether that means a quiet evening away from the spotlight or something more elaborate remains unknown.

Given how carefully the pair have protected their private life since their wedding, the most likely answer may simply be that whatever Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce have planned, they intend to keep it between themselves.

articles.standfirst: Clash of undefeated teams in Las Vegas: Raiders and Chiefs kick off Week 4 with the West lead on the line
articles.summary: Clash of undefeated teams in Las Vegas: Raiders and Chiefs kick off Week 4 with the West lead on the line
articles.body:
There aren't many guarantees in the NFL , but one always holds true: when the Las Vegas Raiders and Kansas City Chiefs meet, it's a battle. This Sunday, October 4th , Allegiant Stadium will be the stage for a divisional showdown between two teams with perfect records and the top spot in the AFC West on the line.

Where to watch and at what time starts today's Chiefs vs Raiders game?

The Week 4 game between Kansas City and Las Vegas will be played at Allegiant Stadium, home of the Raiders. Kickoff is scheduled for 4:25 pm ET (3:25 pm CT and 1:25 pm PT).

In the United States, this Sunday's game can be seen live on CBS television, and for streaming, the Chiefs vs. Raiders game can be viewed on Paramount+.

Two undefeated teams with very different histories

Both teams arrive in Las Vegas with a 3-0 record, but their paths have been different. The Chiefs are the undisputed leaders of the entire league in the overall standings , backed by 88 points for and just 50 against, for a +38 point differential that tops the rankings.

articles.standfirst: The Chiefs quarterback has looked strong so far, but one small detail caught fans' attention in Las Vegas
articles.summary: The Chiefs quarterback has looked strong so far, but one small detail caught fans' attention in Las Vegas
articles.body:
The offseason predictions were not clear-cut for Patrick Mahomes and the Chiefs. However, once it was announced that the quarterback would be ready to return in Week 1, the outlook started to shift in their favor.

A strong start to the season has made things look even better, although it is still too early to be overly critical. Still, a video has now left some fans concerned about Mahomes and his physical condition.

Fans are keeping a close eye on Mahomes

Mahomes has been in a good moment following his surgery, with his performances showing positive results. His physical condition, however, has remained a major focus for fans who do not want to see another injury affect his career. His arrival in Las Vegas caught the attention of some of the more observant fans.

Mahomes arrived in Las Vegas looking sharp and focused on what he had to do in the days ahead . His outfit was on point as usual, but as he walked down the plane stairs with a suitcase and backpack in hand, some fans noticed he appeared to put more weight on his left leg.

A small detail raises some questions

As he stepped down, Mahomes seemed more cautious when using his right leg , making it look as if something could be bothering him. Some fans also noticed that he was relying more on his left knee . It is possible that he was simply being careful with the knee that previously underwent surgery, but t he movement still caught some people off guard.

There is no doubt that losing Mahomes would be a major blow, even this early in the season. The moment began raising alarms among the more concerned fans, especially since no discomfort has been reported by the coaching staff.

Now, with the Chiefs visiting Las Vegas, there should be a little more clarity as Mahomes and the team prepare for the most interesting NFL game of the week . Both the Chiefs and Raiders enter Week 4 at 3-0 after impressive starts, meaning one team's perfect record will end this week.

The Chiefs are listed as 4.5-point road favorites for Sunday's matchup, but sportsbooks have seen the public split over which team will cover.

articles.title: Rashee Rice suffers worrying injury vs. Raiders: Is it Tyreek Hill time for the Chiefs?
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs may be without their No. 1 wide receiver for an extended period of time.
articles.summary: The Chiefs may be without their No. 1 wide receiver for an extended period of time.
articles.body:
It appears that the Kansas City Chiefs could be without Rashee Rice in the starting lineup going forward. During Sunday's game against the Las Vegas Raiders , Rice awkwardly pulled up after trying to run after a catch. His left knee hit the ground and caused him to stumble. Rice then hobbled out of bounds.

The non-contact injury had everyone worrying about his knee, but Rice actually grabbed at his hamstring. The team then announced that he was questionable to return to the game with a hamstring injury . Rice ended up heading to the locker room with trainers.

Given Rice's injury history, especially coming off of knee surgery in the offseason, the Chiefs will likely play it very safe with their top wide receiver. An MRI will confirm the severity of Rice's injury, which could range from a hamstring pull to a full tear .

Rashee Rice's hamstring injury could open the door for Tyreek Hill-Chiefs reunion

With Rice potentially out for multiple games, Chiefs fans are already calling for the team to sign Tyreek Hill . The former Chief has a lot of familiarity with Patrick Mahomes and the Kansas City coaching staff, so the acclimation process would be seamless.

The team was already rumored to be exploring a trade for Hill last season . Of course, the situation has changed due to Hill's brutal knee injury suffered in 2025. But recent videos of Hill shows he's progressing nicely. He could be a logical signing, at least as depth if Rice is out for a while.

articles.title: Taylor Swift turns into a blushing fan watching steamy scene for Patient Zero
articles.standfirst: Swift showed that even she can get caught up in the moment when her own creative work brings two great actors together
articles.summary: Swift showed that even she can get caught up in the moment when her own creative work brings two great actors together
articles.body:
T aylor Swift is one of the most recognized stars in the entertainment industry , but her creativity goes beyond writing songs and composing melodies.

Her creative process also extends to the visual side of her work, which has become an important part of her projects. For Swift, that means not only the theatrical elements, but also the acting and performances featured in her music videos.

Swift still gets excited by the art she creates

For Swift, art can exist in any format , and despite being an established artist, she still gets excited about creating something she knows will bring emotion to her fans. That passion also seems to be part of the satisfaction she gets from putting together visual pieces filled with meaning and details worth noticing.

For the Patient Zero video, Swift not only worked with iconic cinematographer Emmanuel Lubezki, but also brought in Dakota Fanning and Colin Farrell as its stars . The two actors showed their professionalism while filming a steamy scene that left Swift curled up with excitement and blushing as she watched them bring it to life.

Swift looked more like a fan than the artist behind the project

A behind-the-scenes look at Patient Zero captured Swift watching the actors deliver the scene, unable to hide her excited reaction. As Da kota and Colin gave the moment everything it needed, Swift curled up in excitement and appeared completely captivated by what she was seeing.

Swift later described the scene as perfect, admitting that the actors had made her feel all kinds of things with their performance.

The video ultimately showed Swift as a fan of her friends as she watched them create art in real time. For a moment, she looked less like the established artist behind the project and more like a fan getting to watch her own work come together.

articles.title: Tyquan Thornton suffers gruesome injury right after Rashee Rice hamstring injury, and Chiefs fans are begging for Tyreek Hill
articles.standfirst: The Kansas City Chiefs have seen their wide receiver depth decimate in just one day.
articles.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs have seen their wide receiver depth decimate in just one day.
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs just seem to be snake-bitten at the wide receiver position. Early on in the team's game against the Las Vegas Raiders on Sunday, No. 1 wideout Rashee Rice had to leave the game due to a hamstring injury that occurred in non-contact fashion.

Thankfully for the Chiefs, Tyquan Thornton had stepped up in his place and made big plays. But on one of those big plays, Thornton himself got injured, and it was a gruesome one.

Thornton got behind the defense and secured a long pass from Patrick Mahomes . While sprinting towards the end zone, the defender dragged Thornton down, and the wideout's foot got trapped underneath the tackler.

Thornton, full of adrenaline after the big play, tried to stand up and celebrate. But he couldn't put any weight on his left foot, as it was dangling near the ankle area. It was a tough scene

Thornton is more than likely done for the rest of the season, leaving the Chiefs painfully thin at wide receiver, especially if Rice is out for an extended period of time.

With that in mind, calls for the team to sign Tyreek Hill will only grow now. Hill has practically been begging for a reunion in Kansas City, and it seems like it might finally happen now.

articles.title: Chiefs beat the Raiders 30-27 to move to 4-0 behind Patrick Mahomes and Kenneth Walker III
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs lost two wide receivers to injuries and still found a way to win.
articles.summary: The Chiefs lost two wide receivers to injuries and still found a way to win.
articles.body:
P atrick Mahomes remained undefeated at Allegiant Stadium , passing for 225 yards and two touchdowns, and Kenneth Walker III rushed for 177 yards and two TDs to lead the Chiefs to a 30-27 victory over the Las Vegas Raiders on Sunday.

Walker's 2-yard touchdown run with 3:21 left put the Chiefs (4-0) ahead for good at 23-19. It was set up by Tyquan Thornton 's 55-yard reception on the previous play. Thornton, who had five catches for 111 yards and two touchdowns, suffered a gruesome-looking left leg injury on the play and was carted off.

Kirk Cousins passed for 365 yards and two touchdowns for the Raiders, ending his seven-game winning streak that included the final four games last season with Atlanta. Brock Bowers , who played with an illness, caught six passes for 86 yards and a TD.

Las Vegas' running game produced just 72 yards, averaging 2.8 per carry.

One of the NFL's early-season surprises, the Raiders put up a strong fight against their AFC West rivals, and first-year coach Klint Kubiak expressed confidence in his team at halftime.

“ We're winning ,” Kubiak said on the CBS broadcast. “ We're going to win the game .”

Las Vegas certainly gave it a shot, taking a 13-10 advantage into the fourth quarter.

The lead didn't last long. Walker ended the third by busting free for a 76-yard run before he was chased down from behind by Raiders cornerback Taron Johnson at the 8-yard line. Two plays later, the Chiefs took their first lead on Mahomes' 8-yard scoring pass to Thornton.

It was the first time the Raiders' defense had been scored on in the fourth quarter this season.

Las Vegas came right back, with Matt Gay making field goals of 44 and 48 yards for a 19-17 lead with 4:53 left.

But it's hard to count out Mahomes in Las Vegas — or most places. He led the go-ahead touchdown drive and then took advantage of a fumble on the ensuing kickoff by handing the ball to Walker for another TD. Mahomes has won all six of his starts at Allegiant Stadium against the Raiders, plus the Super Bowl after the 2023 season.

Kansas City's Andy Reid , amazingly, has the most wins of any coach at Allegiant with seven. He broke a tie with former Raiders coaches Josh McDaniels and Antonio Pierce . Reid is 7-1 at the stadium, which opened in 2020.

The Chiefs held off a frantic comeback attempt in the final minutes. Cousins hit Bowers for a 20-yard touchdown with 1:46 left and the Raiders got the ball back, moving to midfield before Cousins was intercepted.

articles.title: Tyreek Hill’s Chiefs reunion suddenly looks realistic after Week 4 injuries
articles.standfirst: Kansas City lost two key wide receivers Sunday, and Hill’s latest message came at a striking moment
articles.summary: Kansas City lost two key wide receivers Sunday, and Hill’s latest message came at a striking moment
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs are 4-0, but their perfect start came with a potentially costly setback at wide receiver.

Rashee Rice left Sunday’s 30-27 victory over the Las Vegas Raiders with a hamstring injury in the first quarter.

Then Tyquan Thornton , who had emerged as one of Patrick Mahomes ’ most productive targets, suffered a dislocated left ankle after catching a 55-yard pass in the fourth quarter. Thornton finished with five catches for 111 yards and two touchdowns before leaving the game.

That combination of injuries immediately changed the conversation around a player who has been hovering over the Chiefs all season: Tyreek Hill.

Shortly after Thornton’s injury, Hill posted one word on X: "Hm"

On its own, the message means very little. In the context of Hill’s recent social-media activity, his injury recovery and Kansas City’s sudden need for another explosive receiver, however, it landed differently.

And now there is more than social-media speculation. The Chiefs have reportedly reached out to Hill’s agent, Drew Rosenhaus , about a potential reunion, according to The Athletic's Mike Silver.

Hill is believed to be targeting a return in November, although his health remains the biggest variable. That makes Hill’s "Hm" post look considerably more interesting.

Hill has been preparing for an NFL comeback

Hill , 32, has spent the year recovering from the severe knee injury that ended his 2025 season with the Miami Dolphins . The injury involved a dislocated knee and multiple torn ligaments, including the ACL, and his recovery has been a long process.

In July, Hill acknowledged that his injured leg still lacked strength but said his rehabilitation was moving in the right direction.

“I ain’t going to tell you what my timeline is, but timeline looking real good right now, man,” Hill said at the time.

He also explained the extent of the rehabilitation process. “So it’s about 10 months after doing two surgeries,” Hill said. “My left leg is the one that I injured. I have no power in my left leg at all, so I’m trying to regain all the power back in my left leg. But it’s one day at a time.”

Since then, Hill has repeatedly posted workout footage while making comments that have kept fans guessing about his next move.

After a fan questioned whether he could still play at his age, Hill responded: "32 is not old still prime years"

Then, while watching Week 3, he wrote: "It’s almost time to get off the couch and get to work,"

A couple of days later came another intriguing message: "I think I’m ready for some cold weather."

That last post particularly fueled Kansas City speculation. Hill spent the first six seasons of his career with the Chiefs , and cold-weather football in Kansas City would be a familiar setting for the veteran receiver.

Hill remains one of the most accomplished players in franchise history. From 2016 through 2021, he caught 479 passes for 6,630 yards and 56 touchdowns with Kansas City.

He also played a major role in the Chiefs ' Super Bowl LIV championship and developed one of the NFL's most dangerous connections with Mahomes .

The fit therefore goes beyond nostalgia. Kansas City currently needs receiving help, while Hill needs an opportunity to prove he can still contribute at the highest level.

Mahomes has already spoken positively about his former teammate this season. On Sept. 9, Hill described his former quarterback as a "different man" after ESPN’s Adam Schefter reported that Mahomes would return for Week 1, only nine months after suffering ACL and LCL tears.

Now the Chiefs have another reason to consider bringing Hill home.

Rice's hamstring injury and Thornton's ankle injury leave Kansas City needing to determine how much depth it can trust around Mahomes. Xavier Worthy also has been dealing with a shoulder issue, although he played against Las Vegas.

Kansas City has plenty of reasons to be cautious. Hill has not played since September 2025, and a November comeback would come after an extremely serious knee injury.

The Chiefs would need to establish exactly what he can offer physically before relying on him during a Super Bowl push. But the circumstances have changed dramatically.

Earlier this year, a Hill return to Kansas City looked more like an entertaining possibility than a realistic roster move. After Sunday's injuries, the need is obvious. The Chiefs remain undefeated, Mahomes is healthy and the team has legitimate championship ambitions.

And Hill has made it clear that he believes he still has football left. Now, according to the latest reporting, Kansas City has at least started the conversation.

For a player who spent six seasons helping make the Chiefs one of the NFL's most explosive offenses, the timing could hardly be more intriguing.

Hill has been preparing for an NFL comeback

Hill , 32, has spent the year recovering from the severe knee injury that ended his 2025 season with the Miami Dolphins . The injury involved a dislocated knee and multiple torn ligaments, including the ACL, and his recovery has been a long process.
In July, Hill acknowledged that his injured leg still lacked strength but said his rehabilitation was moving in the right direction.
“I ain’t going to tell you what my timeline is, but timeline looking real good right now, man,” Hill said at the time.

He also explained the extent of the rehabilitation process. “So it’s about 10 months after doing two surgeries,” Hill said. “My left leg is the one that I injured. I have no power in my left leg at all, so I’m trying to regain all the power back in my left leg. But it’s one day at a time.”
Since then, Hill has repeatedly posted workout footage while making comments that have kept fans guessing about his next move.
After a fan questioned whether he could still play at his age, Hill responded: "32 is not old still prime years"
Then, while watching Week 3, he wrote: "It’s almost time to get off the couch and get to work,"
A couple of days later came another intriguing message: "I think I’m ready for some cold weather."

That last post particularly fueled Kansas City speculation. Hill spent the first six seasons of his career with the Chiefs , and cold-weather football in Kansas City would be a familiar setting for the veteran receiver.
Hill remains one of the most accomplished players in franchise history. From 2016 through 2021, he caught 479 passes for 6,630 yards and 56 touchdowns with Kansas City.
He also played a major role in the Chiefs ' Super Bowl LIV championship and developed one of the NFL's most dangerous connections with Mahomes .
The fit therefore goes beyond nostalgia. Kansas City currently needs receiving help, while Hill needs an opportunity to prove he can still contribute at the highest level.

Mahomes has already spoken positively about his former teammate this season. On Sept. 9, Hill described his former quarterback as a "different man" after ESPN’s Adam Schefter reported that Mahomes would return for Week 1, only nine months after suffering ACL and LCL tears.
Now the Chiefs have another reason to consider bringing Hill home.

Rice's hamstring injury and Thornton's ankle injury leave Kansas City needing to determine how much depth it can trust around Mahomes. Xavier Worthy also has been dealing with a shoulder issue, although he played against Las Vegas.
Kansas City has plenty of reasons to be cautious. Hill has not played since September 2025, and a November comeback would come after an extremely serious knee injury.
The Chiefs would need to establish exactly what he can offer physically before relying on him during a Super Bowl push. But the circumstances have changed dramatically.

Earlier this year, a Hill return to Kansas City looked more like an entertaining possibility than a realistic roster move. After Sunday's injuries, the need is obvious. The Chiefs remain undefeated, Mahomes is healthy and the team has legitimate championship ambitions.
And Hill has made it clear that he believes he still has football left. Now, according to the latest reporting, Kansas City has at least started the conversation.
For a player who spent six seasons helping make the Chiefs one of the NFL's most explosive offenses, the timing could hardly be more intriguing.

articles.title: Brittany Mahomes' taunt following the Chiefs' victory over the Raiders
articles.standfirst: Patrick Mahomes' wife made sure to remind the Raiders of their coach's bold halftime prediction after Kansas City's comeback win
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes' wife made sure to remind the Raiders of their coach's bold halftime prediction after Kansas City's comeback win
articles.body:
B rittany Mahomes clearly wasn't going to let Klint Kubiak 's halftime prediction go unnoticed after the Kansas City Chiefs rallied to beat the Las Vegas Raiders on Sunday.

The Chiefs erased a fourth-quarter deficit to secure a 30-27 victory at Allegiant Stadium, maintaining their perfect start to the 2026 NFL season. Kansas City moved to 4-0, while the Raiders suffered their first defeat and fell to 3-1.

For Brittany , however, the final score wasn't the only reason to celebrate. She appeared to have been keeping track of what Kubiak said during the CBS broadcast at halftime, when the Raiders were leading 13-10.

Speaking with CBS sideline reporter Tracy Wolfson , Kubiak acknowledged that his team needed to improve but confidently predicted that Las Vegas would finish the job.

“Gotta be better, but you know what? We’re winning. We’re gonna win the game,” the first-year Raiders head coach told Wolfson. The prediction ultimately came back to haunt him.

Rather than simply enjoying the Chiefs' comeback, Brittany used Kubiak's own words as the caption for a post on social media, making the reference impossible to miss.

“We’re winning. We’re gonna win the game,” she captioned her postgame post.

The message quickly attracted attention from Chiefs supporters, many of whom enjoyed the timing of the post after Kansas City had completed the comeback.

“Raiders coach has won 3 games and thinks he’s John Madden ,” one fan wrote.

“BRITTTTTTTT came with receiptsssssss,” one fan added.

“I KNEW his comment was gonna backfire and was waiting,” one fan added.

“He was too confident… should of kept that to himself… GO CHIEFS !” one fan added.

“The caption understood the assignment,” one fan added.

“I had the same thought when he was saying this,” one fan added.

Even NFL on FOX sideline reporter Erin Andrews appeared to appreciate the comment from Mrs. Mahomes , commenting a handful of fire emojis.

The Chiefs found another way to escape a tough AFC West battle

Brittany's post came after what was ultimately a dramatic night for Kansas City.

The Raiders entered the matchup unbeaten and looked capable of handing the Chiefs their first loss. Las Vegas led at halftime and remained in front deep into the fourth quarter, putting Kubiak's prediction within reach before Kansas City produced another late comeback.

Patrick Mahomes wasn't spectacular statistically, completing 15 of 30 passes for 225 yards and two touchdowns, but he avoided an interception and helped Kansas City execute when the game was on the line.

The biggest offensive difference came from Kenneth Walker III . The running back exploded for 177 rushing yards and two touchdowns, including a pivotal 76-yard run that helped swing momentum toward the Chiefs.

Kansas City also had to overcome a difficult night on the injury front. Tyquan Thornton caught five passes for 111 yards and two touchdowns before suffering a serious left-leg injury, while Rashee Rice also exited with a hamstring problem.

Thornton's injury is expected to keep him out for an extended period, adding an unwanted complication to an otherwise perfect start.

The result nevertheless leaves the Chiefs as the AFC's only unbeaten team after Week 4. They will now enter their bye week at 4-0, giving Andy Reid and his staff time to assess both their impressive start and the mounting injuries.

The Raiders , meanwhile, have plenty of reasons for optimism despite the defeat. Kubiak has helped turn the team into a competitive 3-1 club after Las Vegas struggled badly in 2025, and Sunday's game showed that the gap between the two AFC West teams may be narrowing.

But on Sunday night, Kansas City had the final word. And Brittany Mahomes made sure Kubiak's halftime prediction got one more airing, this time with the final score attached to it.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes gives Fernando Mendoza some advice about Kirk Cousins
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes watched Fernando Mendoza from the opposite sideline Sunday night and saw something very familiar.
articles.body:
Patrick Mahomes watched Fernando Mendoza from the opposite sideline Sunday night and saw something very familiar.

The Las Vegas Raiders rookie remains behind Kirk Cousins on the depth chart, much like Mahomes spent his first NFL season learning behind Alex Smith before taking over Kansas City’s offense in 2018. Mahomes believes that arrangement can work in Mendoza ’s favor.

“It’s going to do a lot of great things for him,” Mahomes said. “Kirk is a true pro. It’ll be great for Fernando to learn and just take in.

“Hopefully not too much, because it went really well for me and Alex. Maybe not that much unless I’m gone, or something like that.”

Raiders resisting urge to rush Mendoza

Las Vegas has little incentive to force Mendoza onto the field while Cousins continues to perform. The veteran has helped the Raiders to a 3-1 start, throwing for 1,026 yards and 11 touchdowns through four games.

Even in Sunday night’s 30-27 loss to Kansas City, Cousins threw for 365 yards and two scores and gave the Raiders a chance late. That success gives Mendoza something many highly drafted quarterbacks never receive, which is time.

Raiders general manager John Spytek made that point before the season, noting that team performance would influence when Mendoza eventually gets his opportunity.

“If Kirk’s in there and we’re 7-3 after 10 games, that’s different than if we’re 3-7,” Spytek said. “That’s probably ultimately what kept Mahomes on the bench. They were in the playoffs. They were in the race through the whole thing.”

Mahomes understands that logic better than anyone.

Cousins believes playing well part of mentoring Mendoza

Cousins has also embraced the responsibility that comes with having the No.1 pick watching him.

“Kirk Cousins told me, ‘Hey man, the best thing I can do for Fernando Mendoza is play great and show him what an NFL offense is supposed to look like. That’s the best thing I can do for him,’” Mark Schlereth said on The Rich Eisen Show.

That approach removes some of the pressure from Mendoza to justify his draft status immediately. The Raiders can allow him to study protections, timing and game management without asking him to solve every problem from Week 1.

Mahomes ’ own career is the obvious model. He started only the 2017 regular-season finale as a rookie, then took over the following year and quickly became the face of the Chiefs .

Las Vegas would gladly accept anything close to that development curve with Mendoza . Mahomes , naturally, would prefer the comparison stops before Mendoza turns into another AFC West problem.

articles.title: Chiefs remain the AFC only undefeated team as Patrick Mahomes knows how this hot start can lead them back to the Super Bowl
articles.standfirst: This marks the fourth time in nine seasons that Mahomes and the Chiefs have started the season with a 4-0 record
articles.summary: This marks the fourth time in nine seasons that Mahomes and the Chiefs have started the season with a 4-0 record
articles.body:
Throughout the NFL , finding an easy matchup is virtually impossible, with nearly every victory hard-fought and contested down to the final seconds. This razor-thin margin for error was vividly illustrated in Week 3 , where 12 of the 14 Sunday games were decided by a single possession, followed by 11 of 14 games meeting that same dramatic threshold in Week 4.

Across this latest slate, three contests were decided by a mere field goal, highlighted by two pivotal divisional showdowns. Most notably, the New England Patriots handed the Buffalo Bills their first loss of the year, also marking the first defeat in the history of Buffalo's new stadium, by pulling off a stunning 29-26 victory powered by an improbable touchdown from Efton Chism III .

Meanwhile, the premier divisional battle featured the Kansas City Chiefs outlasting the Las Vegas Raiders 30-27 , a thriller where Patrick Mahomes recorded 225 passing yards and two touchdowns , though the spotlight was stolen by Kenneth Walker III , who put on a rushing masterclass with 177 yards and two touchdowns .

Adding to the game's dramatic narrative, receiver Tyquan Thornton enjoyed a career-best outing with 111 yards on 5 receptions and two touchdowns , though the performance was tragically marred by a devastating season-ending injury.

CMahomes Chases Another Historic Super Bowl Run After 4-0 start

With that hard-fought victory, the Chiefs improved to a pristine 4-0 record, standing proudly alongside the San Francisco 49ers and Minnesota Vikings as the only undefeated teams remaining in the NFL.

This marks the fourth time Kansas City has opened a campaign with four straight wins since Patrick Mahomes assumed the starting role in 2018.

Historical precedent heavily favors a deep postseason run whenever the Chiefs hit this early milestone, as three of their previous four-0 starts (2019, 2020, and 2024) ultimately culminated in Super Bowl appearances , resulting in a Lombardi Trophy during the 2019 campaign as the first of three titles captured in the Mahomes era.

Unlike those high-flying aerial attacks of the past, this year's iteration leans heavily on a physical ground game spearheaded by Kenneth Walker III , meaning the team's ceiling will largely track how far Walker can carry them. Yet, Kansas City's ultimate luxury remains having Mahomes at the helm to take over if the run game stalls.

While the journey is just beginning, history shows that when Mahomes and company start 4-0 , they reach the ultimate stage, raising the question of whether they can replicate that magic once again.

Bye Week Arrives as Chiefs Weigh Roster Adjustments for Brutal Stretch

The timing of the upcoming bye week offers Kansas City a crucial window to heal, providing much-needed recovery time for Rashee Rice .

However, following the heartbreaking loss of Tyquan Thornton , the front office faces immense pressure to evaluate wide receiver reinforcements via free agency or a potential trade, with veteran star Tyreek Hill frequently surfacing in speculative discussions.

Once the bye concludes, the Chiefs face a grueling gauntlet of 13 straight games , featuring daunting road trips against Denver, Seattle, Buffalo, Cincinnati, and the Los Angeles Rams, alongside high-profile home clashes against the Patriots and 49ers.

articles.title: New angle shows Tyquan Thornton getting up unaware of horrific injury
articles.standfirst: Thornton’s adrenaline was so high that he appeared not to realize how badly he was hurt
articles.summary: Thornton’s adrenaline was so high that he appeared not to realize how badly he was hurt
articles.body:
The Kansas City Chiefs topped the Las Vegas Raiders 30-27 to keep their perfect 4-0 record, but at the same time, they were dealt a potentially major blow. Wide receiver Tyquan Thornton suffered a gruesome left leg injury late in the fourth quarter that will presumably knock him out for the rest of the campaign.

The images from the moment were intense, but a new fan-shot angle makes the scene even more striking . It shows just how much adrenaline can take over for an athlete , allowing them to keep moving without immediately realizing the physical pain they are experiencing.

A new angle reveals what Thornton did moments after going down

That was exactly what happened with Thornton. The new video shows that he did not appear to realize the seriousness of his injury at the time. Somehow, the Chiefs wide receiver got back to his feet and even signaled for a first down before the pain forced him back to the ground . Head coach Andy Reid later acknowledged that the injury did not look good while also praising Thornton’s attitude.

The adrenaline appeared to mask the severity of the pain for a moment. Thornton eventually went back down because he could not put weight on his foot, which was visibly hanging . It was a difficult scene to watch. After he was back on the ground and unable to get up, Mike Caliendo asked if he was okay. When Thornton mentioned his ankle, Mike could not bring himself to look at it and instead turned away to ask for help.

The Chiefs could now have a major problem at wide receiver

The situation is even more concerning for Kansas City because questions around the receiving corps had already emerged after WR1 Rashee Rice left the game on the second drive with a hamstring strain. The Chiefs could now be without two of their top three wideouts when they return from the bye in Week 6.

Those circumstances have made a potential Tyreek Hill reunion in Kansas City difficult to ignore. Unsurprisingly, more reports linking Hill with his former team have surfaced since the final whistle against the Raiders. Before his injury, Thornton had delivered a huge performance, recording five receptions for 111 yards and two touchdowns in Kansas City’s 30-27 win.

articles.title: Patrick Mahomes now knows when he can get Tyquan Thornton back after his brutal injury
articles.standfirst: The Chiefs could explore the free-agent market to help fill the void left by a player who looked ready to change everything.
articles.summary: The Chiefs could explore the free-agent market to help fill the void left by a player who looked ready to change everything.
articles.body:
T yquan Thornton touched heaven and hell within minutes. The Kansas City Chiefs receiver turned in the performance of his life in a nail-biting 30-27 win over the Las Vegas Raiders , securing the AFC West lead, but he ended up leaving the field on a stretcher with a devastating injury that puts his season in jeopardy.

The 26-year-old receiver suffered a dislocated ankle in the fourth quarter and will need immediate surgery. Still, it isn't all bad news in Andy Reid 's locker room: there is a small ray of hope that he could return before the end of the year.

Will he make the playoffs?

According to a report from CBS Sports' Matt Zenitz , the estimated recovery time is three to four months. If the timeline holds without setbacks, Thornton could be back in January , just in time for the final stretch of the regular season and the start of the playoffs.

Despite the moderate optimism, the front office led by Brett Veach knows it can't sit idle and is already weighing options on the market.

The "ghost" of Tyreek Hill returns

With Thornton out, Tyreek Hill 's name is once again ringing loudly in Kansas City's offices. The former Super Bowl LIV champion hasn't played since the serious knee injury he suffered in September 2025. Although questions remain about his physical condition at 32, his explosive chemistry with Patrick Mahomes keeps him as the dream candidate for Chiefs fans.

The loss hits Kansas City where it hurts. The 2022 second-round draft pick was finally tapping into the potential that had been demanded of him since he arrived in the NFL.

Against the Raiders, Thornton had a dream game with five receptions, 111 yards and two touchdowns, including a spectacular 55-yard catch that set up the winning score with 3:35 left on the clock.

Now, both Thornton and the Chiefs begin a race against time with their sights set on January.
